name: CSV to JSON
summary: Convert CSV to JSON with advanced options — delimiter, headers, type inference, array or object output.
description: Paste CSV and convert to JSON locally. Advanced options: delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe), header row toggle, type inference, trim fields, skip empty rows, and output as objects or arrays. Quoted fields and commas inside quotes are supported.

faqs.question: What advanced options are available?
faqs.answer: Delimiter, first-row headers, infer numbers/booleans/null, trim fields, skip empty rows, and objects vs arrays output.

faqs.question: Must the first row be headers?
faqs.answer: Only if “First row is header” is on. With headers off and object output, keys become column_1, column_2, …

faqs.question: How are numbers and booleans handled?
faqs.answer: When type inference is on, bare numbers become JSON numbers and true/false/null become booleans/null. Turn inference off to keep everything as strings.

faqs.question: Is my CSV uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
